# Uiverse elements used by this site

Source: <https://github.com/uiverse-io/galaxy> — MIT (see `LICENSE`, © 2023 Uiverse.io).

The site does **not** load these files. They are kept here as the provenance record for CSS
that was adapted into `src/layout.html`: the licence requires the copyright notice to travel
with any substantial portion of the work, and Uiverse asks that the original creator be
credited. Keeping the unmodified originals next to the licence makes both verifiable instead of
asking a reader to take the attribution on trust.

| File | Creator | What the site took |
|---|---|---|
| `adamgiebl_curvy-earwig-79.html` | [adamgiebl](https://uiverse.io/adamgiebl) | The two-layer `linear-gradient` graph-paper grid, in `.grid-bg`. |
| `kennyotsu_short-warthog-33.html` | [kennyotsu](https://uiverse.io/kennyotsu) | The `radial-gradient` dot field, in `.facts`. |
| `Cornerstone-04_bitter-impala-54.html` | [Cornerstone-04](https://uiverse.io/Cornerstone-04) | The two-pseudo-element border-draw hover, in `.draw`. |

Every one was recoloured onto this site's tokens (`--rule`, `--accent`, `--bg`) and had its
radii, shadows and stated colours removed; the originals are light-themed or brightly coloured
and would not have fitted. What survives is the technique, which is the part worth crediting.
